arStrings.szText: The wounds in Skovos are deep, and true healing cannot begin until a new queen rises.

Without a rightful queen, Temis faces an uncertain future. The Council of Veterans intends to appoint a new sovereign, and it has requested my presence, despite my being a mainlander.

The Council convenes in the Tholos of Temis. I must go and learn why I was summoned.

The Council of Veterans revealed its intent to elect a new Queen of Skovos. Tharra and two other captains were chosen as candidates, and now they must complete a rite called the Passage.

Tharra has asked that I stand as her witness. Her first trial begins in Lycander, at the tomb of First Queen Antia, the First Queen. Tharra awaits me there.

Travel to the Sepulcher of the First Amazon

At the threshold of the First Amazon's sepulcher, we discovered it befouled. Corrupted Amazons have stained the sacred ground. The defilers gather on the shore beneath us, blind to our approach.

Tharra wishes to speak with me on the cliffs before we purge the corruption from this place.

At the threshold of the First Amazon's sepulcher, we discovered it befouled. Corrupted Amazons have stained the sacred ground. The defilers gather on the shore beneath us, blind to our approach.

These fallen sisters shall know our wrath.

At the threshold of the First Amazon's sepulcher, we put the corrupted Amazons to the blade for defiling sacred ground and murdering the crypt's innocent guardians.

I can feel Tharra's fury. I must speak with her.

More innocent guards might be in danger within the Sepulcher of the First Amazon. Tharra, driven by righteous fury, would search for survivors and cleanse the tomb of corruption.

This task was not why we came--but it falls to us nonetheless. Hatred has spread too far across these lands.
